source:
@@U00138@@
You'll forgive me, but it’s a great delight
to enter into the spirit of times past;
to know what wise men before us thought,
and then measure how far we've come in the meanwhile.

@@U00140@@
As far as the stars! Yes!
Times past, my friend, are a book with seven seals.
And what you call the spirit of the times
is nothing more than the spirit of you gentlemen
in which the past is reflected.
And a sad affair that reflection is, too!
One glance and you run for your lives.
A trash barrel!
A junk room!
At best, a blood-and-thunder play
with excellent pragmatical maxims
suitable for the mouths of puppets.

@@U00142@@
But what of the world?
What of the hearts and minds of men?
Surely we all want knowledge of such things.

@@U00144@@
Knowledge!
Yes, what’s known as “knowledge.”
That’s what you mean, isn’t it?
But who'll call the child by its right name?
Who would dare?
The few who really knew—the few who were
foolish enough not to keep it to themselves,
who spilled their full hearts to the rabble,
their feelings, their visions,
have from the beginning of time been crucified
and burned at the stake.
But you must excuse me, my friend.
It’s very late; we really must stop for now.
translation:
@@U00138@@
你会原谅我的，但这是一种莫大的快乐
进入过去时代的精神；
了解我们之前的智者的想法，
然后衡量我们在此期间已经走了多远。

@@U00140@@
至星星为止！是的！
我的朋友，过去的时光是一本有七个封印的书。
以及你所谓的时代精神
无非就是你们先生们的精神
其中反映了过去。
这种反思也是一件令人悲伤的事情！
一看，你就逃命了。
一个垃圾桶！
一个垃圾房！
充其量，一场血与雷的比赛
具有出色的务实格言
适合木偶的嘴。

@@U00142@@
但世界又如何呢？
男人的心灵和思想又如何呢？
当然，我们都想了解这些事情。

@@U00144@@
知识！
是的，就是所谓的“知识”。
这就是你的意思，不是吗？
但谁会用正确的名字来称呼孩子呢？
谁敢？
少数真正了解的人——少数真正了解的人
愚蠢到不把它留给自己，
他们向乌合之众倾注了全部心血，
他们的感受，他们的愿景，
从一开始就被钉在十字架上
并被烧死在火刑柱上。
但你必须原谅我，我的朋友。
已经很晚了；我们现在确实必须停下来。
